messages:
Priya Rao: Quick idea for a small, low-risk onboarding runbook: call it 'Sentinel Priming'. Goal: safely prime caches, collect an early quality signal + opt-in feedback, and produce a single CS-friendly risk score. Keep it short so SEs will actually run it.
Ethan Brooks: Sounds useful. can you list the minimal steps? we need to be careful about cost and not touching prod keys.
Priya Rao: Minimal steps (5): 1) create a priming job via the internal /priming API with params: tenant, prompt_bundle, token_budget, sample_rate. 2) run for 24-72h at very low qps (0.2-1 r/s). 3) tag all traces with priming:sentinel and retention:short. 4) compute a daily "sentinel_score" combining conf_avg, p95_latency_delta, and feedback_sentiment. 5) if sentinel_score < threshold -> auto-create CS ticket + attach snapshot.
Sofia Kim: For step 1, example curl? would help SEs.
Priya Rao: Yep. example (safe creds):

curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/priming/jobs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRIMING_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"acct-ABC-priming","prompt_bundle":"onboard-mini","qps":"0.5","duration_h":"48","token_budget":1500,"tags":["priming:sentinel","retention:24h"]}'

That key is scoped to priming budgets only.
Ravi Kapoor: SRE notes: enforce cache namespace isolation (prefix: priming/{tenant}) and put a safety cap: kill job if 5xx_rate > 0.8% for 3 consecutive 5m windows or p95_latency increases >200ms vs tenant baseline for 10m. Also limit concurrent priming jobs per infra pool to avoid noisy neighbors.
Ethan Brooks: How do we score sentinel_score? keep it interpretable for CSMs.
Priya Rao: Use a simple weighted formula: sentinel_score = 0.5*conf_norm + 0.3*(1 - latency_delta_norm) + 0.2*feedback_norm. Normalize values 0-1. Any score < 0.35 => flag as "attention-needed". We'll surface a 3-line summary to CSMs: score, primary cause (latency/confidence/feedback), suggested next step.
Sofia Kim: Feedback capture: avoid spamming customers. microform should be opt-in during provisioning or SE can toggle. sample in-product microform copy: "Quick check: Did responses match what you expected? (Yes / No) - optional 2-line comment" + 1-click skip.
Ravi Kapoor: Privacy/regulatory: mark logs retention:24h and store only hashed response samples + confidence, no raw PII snippets. Make sure default is opt_out_feedback=false but explicit consent required for any stored text beyond hashes.
Priya Rao: For CSM workflow: 1) SE runs priming job and notifies CSM with link 2) CSM monitors daily snapshot for 48h 3) If score < threshold -> CSM runs "mini-triage" checklist: check prompt coverage, ask SE to expand prompt set, propose temporary routing fallback, schedule 7-day technical review with ML infra. We should provide a one-click button to create the triage ticket.
Ethan Brooks: Alert integration: POST to /hooks/cs-alerts with small payload {tenant, score, cause, snapshot_url}. Also create a Zendesk ticket template: subject "[Priming Alert] acct-XXX early signal" body short bulleted metrics + link to snapshot.
Sofia Kim: Can we add a cost guard? e.g., token_budget enforced server-side and stop job when budget exhausted, and add env var PRIMING_OVERRIDE for enterprise trial accounts only.
Priya Rao: Yes - server enforces token_budget. Also include a per-job cost_estimate returned on creation so SEs can preview.
ops-bot: priming-service v2 deployed -> release ok. CI: build #4938 :rocket:
Ravi Kapoor: Ops follow-up: add a visible tag on tenant dashboard "priming_active" and a toggle to opt-out feedback. Also add a small note for CSMs to mention in customer communications: "This run is low-volume and safe; you can opt-out anytime."
Ethan Brooks: I'll draft the SE template email: short instructions + consent language + one-click start link. will share by EOD.
Priya Rao: Great. I'll author the one-page MVP runbook with the curl snippet, scoring logic, triage checklist, and links to the dashboard widgets. Pilot with 3 small customers next sprint. Please keep the runbook under 1 page. :memo:
Sofia Kim: I'll validate data-retention text with legal and paste final copy into runbook.
Priya Rao: Thanks team. tagging @ops-bot if infra changes roll through. We'll reconvene after pilot with metrics: avg_score, number flagged, and customer feedback rate. :white_check_mark:
